local_statistics.numerical_bound: mean_bounds cover radial Taylor truncation only, excluding floating-point error
local_statistics.uncertainty: Monte Carlo integration uncertainty must be computed from independent batch intensity estimates; it is separate from physical disorder variance and interpolation error
local_statistics.sample_memory_scope: one accepted radial array of samples_per_batch times template_atoms; no full-crystal guest draws

uncertainty_note: MC SEM estimates local integration uncertainty; not physical disorder or a strict error bound. Radial bound excludes floating-point and MC error. Both omit q-grid undersampling.
